title: Gluten-Free Crumbly Flaky Pastry
description: A gluten-free pastry made with flaky dough, perfect for snacks or desserts.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Place the pastry dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread the quick fix jam over the center of the pastry dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Sprinkle the crumble topping over the jam.
If desired, add a pinch of pepper to taste.
If desired, sprinkle a tablespoon of gluten-free sugar over the crumble topping.
Fold the edges of the pastry dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Allow the pastry to cool for 5-10 minutes before slicing and serving.
